answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the falcon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the glacier is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
